title: Library computers
text:
Library computers – how to use them

1. Go to the reception and show your library card.
2. The librarian gives you a number. Find the computer with that number.
3. Write your name and card number on the screen.
4. You can use the computer for one hour.
5. You can print five pages for free. After that, one page costs 20p.
6. Don't eat or drink at the computers.
7. When you finish, click "Log out" and close the program.

Do you need help? Ask the librarian. We are happy to help!
